slides.h1: Getting App Store reviews without being annoying.
slides.lead: Ratings are social proof. Ask the right way.
requestReview / SKStoreReviewController. One tap, no leaving the app. Apple caps how often it shows.
When the user just got value from your app. Never on first launch.
Apple wants ratings to go through the system prompt. Don't risk App Review over it.
Put it in settings. Link to your App Store page with ?action=write-review.
You can reply in App Store Connect. A calm answer to a bad review is public too.
Same complaint twice? That's your next update.

slides.h2: Ask at the right moment. Earn the stars.
